overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate the vacation-name topic, so it did not need to be in the notice, including the end-of-meeting discussion and informal vote.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee discussed and voted on a vacation-name topic at its October 14, 2014 meeting although the topic was not listed in the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Chair did not reasonably anticipate that the Committee would discuss the topic at this meeting, only that the issue might be raised by a member of the public, she was not required to list it in the meeting notice.
